clue.text: A picture one will carry everywhere

definitions.text: A picture one will carry everywhere

parts.words: A picture one will carry everywhere
parts.note: an image inked into the skin goes wherever its owner goes, for life

explanation.definitionFit: A design pricked permanently into skin is a picture its bearer can never leave behind.

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of the next words are oddly arranged

explanation.surface: A storyteller's aside, 'strange to relate', about something put up with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strange' signals rearranging the eight letters of 'to relate'.
explanation.definitionFit: To endure something is to put up with it, a straightforward synonym.

parts.note: a cruciform church has a crosswise arm, literally the section forming the cross, not a diagram cut through it

explanation.definitionFit: In a cross-shaped church the arms crossing the nave form exactly that cross section of the building.

clue.text: Duck and swan up in the air

parts.note: a duck is a zero score in cricket, shaped like the letter O
a pen is a female swan

explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' and 'swan' read as birds aloft, but 'up in the air' is the definition meaning undecided.
explanation.definitionFit: A question still up in the air is undecided, unresolved, not yet closed.

clue.text: Reckon the deceased's property is about one thousand

indicators.note: is about says the property surrounds the other letters

parts.note: an estate is everything a dead person leaves
I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: An executor guesses the value of a dead person's possessions.
explanation.definitionFit: To reckon a figure is to estimate it, a verb synonym for making a rough calculation.

clue.text: The last fish in the sea?

definitions.text: The last fish in the sea?

parts.words: The last fish in the sea?
parts.note: a flatfish of one particular kind left alone as the only one remaining alive

explanation.definitionFit: The only one left alive after others perish; the flatfish named sole makes the pun.

clue.text: Football field lacking parking is cause of irritation

indicators.note: lacking says a letter is taken away from the field

parts.note: a football field is a pitch
P is the map abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A football ground with no car park annoys the fans.
explanation.definitionFit: An itch is a tickling sensation that irritates the skin until scratched.

clue.text: Publicity is about over for this handsome youth

indicators.note: in a down clue over says the first piece sits above the next one

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: Media coverage of a good-looking young man is dying down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' places ON above IS in this down entry; 'about' gives ON, as in a book on birds.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Adonis was a beautiful youth loved by Aphrodite; his name now means any handsome young man.

definitions.meaning: a social class or order, as in the three ... of the realm
the whole of a person's property and possessions

explanation.definitionFit: An estate is both an order of society and the total property someone owns.

definitions.meaning: a newspaper's main opinion article, also called a leading article
the head person, the one in charge

explanation.definitionFit: A leading newspaper article and a person in charge share the same word.

clue.text: Wrong time to leave the factory?

definitions.meaning: a timepiece that is out, showing the incorrect hour
to register departure from work on a time recorder

explanation.definitionFit: A timepiece that is out is wrong, and workers punch a card on leaving the shift.

definitions.meaning: a brief, short-lived liking that soon fades
read literally, a desire to get past the vehicle in front

explanation.definitionFit: A short-lived craze, and read literally a wish to go past another car on the road.

clue.text: It can be used in billiards break

definitions.text: It can be used in billiards
definitions.meaning: a cue support players lay the cue on for awkward shots
a pause or interval

explanation.definitionFit: A cue support at the billiard table and a pause both carry this name.

clue.text: Uplift revealed by bra is exciting

indicators.note: revealed by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A lingerie advert promising a thrilling lift.
explanation.definitionFit: To uplift something is to lift it higher, a verb synonym.

definitions.meaning: an archaic verb meaning listen
a ship leaning to one side

explanation.definitionFit: An old word for listening and a nautical word for leaning to one side.

clue.text: Too much interest is shown in it

definitions.text: Too much interest is shown in it

parts.words: Too much interest is shown in it
parts.note: the interest is money charged on a loan, not curiosity

explanation.definitionFit: Lending money at an excessive interest rate is the practice condemned under this name.

clue.text: This dance can go all over the place!

indicators.note: all over the place says the letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A dance where people snake about anywhere they like.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin American party dance done in a long snaking line.

clue.text: Wrong impression of a key worker

definitions.text: Wrong impression of a key worker

parts.words: Wrong impression of a key worker
parts.note: the impression is a printed character, and the key worker strikes keys on a keyboard

explanation.definitionFit: A mistyped letter is a slip made by someone whose job is striking keys.

parts.note: not a small bedside lamp but a natural shaft of light seen at night

explanation.definitionFit: A ray reflected from the lunar surface lights up the night sky.

clue.text: In a religious sense he doesn't believe in coasting freely

definitions.text: In a religious sense he doesn't believe

indicators.note: freely says the letters move around without restraint

explanation.surface: A doubter who refuses to take life easy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who holds that God's existence cannot be known neither believes nor denies, an unbeliever in a religious sense.

parts.note: air means a tune, not an atmosphere, sung at a merry gathering over drinks

explanation.definitionFit: A tune sung by revellers at the pub is a song of good-fellowship.

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor; with the 's it gives ABS
an orb is a sphere, the globe

explanation.surface: Taking in a seafarer's whole world.
explanation.definitionFit: To absorb ideas is to take them in fully, a synonym of assimilate.

indicators.note: distributing says the letters are dealt out into a new order

explanation.surface: A trade body handing out red wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartel is an association of firms that agree to fix prices or output.

definitions.meaning: a bird's bill
old British slang for a schoolmaster, and also for a magistrate

explanation.definitionFit: A bird's bill and, in old British slang, a teacher or magistrate.

definitions.meaning: astir, in progress, as in 'something is going on'
a single unit of twelve inches, split into two words

explanation.definitionFit: Plans that are about are under way; split in two, the word is one imperial length unit.

definitions.meaning: to unfasten, as with a button or knot
to bring to ruin, as in 'his pride was his ...'

explanation.definitionFit: To unfasten something and to bring someone to ruin share the same verb.

definitions.meaning: a raised knob or ornamental stud
the person in charge at work

explanation.definitionFit: A boss is a round knob on a surface and also the person in charge.

clue.text: Pole enters by way of a special permit

indicators.note: enters says the pole goes inside the phrase meaning by way of

parts.note: via means by way of
S is the South Pole

explanation.surface: A Polish traveller entering a country through a special permit scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A visa is a stamped endorsement permitting entry to a foreign country.

definitions.meaning: leaving office, as an ... chairman
sociable and friendly

explanation.definitionFit: A departing office-holder and a sociable person are both described by this word.

definitions.meaning: straightforward and plain
to command or instruct

explanation.definitionFit: Plain speaking is straightforward, and to instruct someone is to command them.

definitions.meaning: a lantern with a thick convex lens, or a small thick round window pane
a hard round striped mint sweet, a British favourite

explanation.definitionFit: Both a lantern with a bulging lens and a striped British boiled mint go by this name.

clue.text: Sailor joins a Scotsman on the roads

definitions.note: a noun phrase standing for the surfacing material laid on the roads

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor
Mac is a stock name for a Scotsman, from the surname prefix

explanation.surface: A seaman and a Scot set off together on the highway.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarmac is the asphalt surfacing material laid on roads and runways.
